name: Oriented Bipartite-Graph Class Construction
definition: For a finite oriented simple bipartite graph $G$, use one private coordinate per vertex and three controls. At private support $T$, allow all eight control words if $T=\varnothing$; all but $+++$ or $---$, according to the vertex side, if $T=\{v\}$; the singleton $++-$ or $--+$ prescribed by the orientation if $T$ is an edge; and no words otherwise.
parameters: Finite simple bipartite graph with one orientation per edge; the empty graph is allowed by the convention $C(\varnothing)=\{0,1\}^3$.
properties: If $m=|V(G)|$ and $e=|E(G)|$, then $|C(G)|=8+7m+e$, its VC dimension is three, and it is convex-realizable, dismantlable ample, and finite convex-treelike. Conditioning private coordinates outside an induced subgraph $H$ to zero gives $C(H)$.
